## Change and reason

Describe the observable change and relevant requirement/work-item IDs.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and material limitations. Distinguish synthetic/local evidence from independent editorial, fluent-language, privacy and release approval.

## Scope and sources

State any capability/locale, dependency, licence, source or methodology changes and applicable gate packet. Preserve exact citations and unscored unknowns. Keep the generated plan/Markdown and agent guidance consistent.

Do not include real answers, affinities, constituency choices, credentials or private logs. Party-specific personalised results require explicit finish.
